name: poly-lifecycle-ownership
description: Direct pattern identity and transactional bank publication. Owners are four index+1 words at CCM D740; reset zeroes banks and owners before constructors. No selector relabels an unchanged bank.

patches.note: Read to scratch before publishing bank and its owner
Empty native save unlinks the matching sidecar and clears its owned bank
Empty-pattern save extends the existing unlink route
Extend reset CCM zero bound through all banks and ownership words
